verdict.rationale: Shopify documents GraphiQL, an in-browser explorer for writing, validating, and executing queries and mutations against the GraphQL Admin API. It also publishes reference documentation for the Admin and Storefront APIs, which together cover the core of an interactive, runnable API reference. missing for 10: explicit evidence that reference pages embed runnable examples inline (rather than only a separate explorer), an interactive explorer documented for the Storefront API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the explorer experience.
